icons.name: folder
icons.description: A horizontal rounded folder with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original horizontal folder silhouette with one outer contour and a recognizable tab. Bounds x=3..21 and y=5..19 preserve the rectangular aspect ratio: at stroke 1.75, visible left/right padding is 2.125 units and top/bottom padding is 4.125 units. Opposite sides match exactly; horizontal and vertical pairs may differ. The front-panel upper edge is a single straight stroke at y=11, without retracing the sides or bottom. Existing body/lid names, stroke defaults and motion recipe are retained for static review.
